March 9-13, 2020 | www.ceraweek.com 
Media Registration is Now Open for CERAWeek by IHS Markit 2020 
 
Applications for media registration can be submitted at the following link: 
https://bit.ly/2LoeSGU 
All members of the media interested in attending CERAWeek 2020 are required to apply for 
accreditation. 
Complete details related to media registration are included below in this email. 
 
About CERAWeek 2020 
CERAWeek 2020 will kick off Monday, March 9 at the Hilton Americas-Houston. 
CERAWeek by IHS Markit is the premier annual international gathering of energy industry 
leaders, experts, government officials and policymakers, leaders from the technology, financial 
and industrial communities – and energy technology innovators. Chaired by Daniel Yergin, 
CERAWeek 2020 will be the event’s 39th installment. 
Visit www.ceraweek.com for the most up-to-date event information and follow us via 
@CERAWeek. Listed session times, topics and speakers are subject to change.  
  
Media Registration Details: 
All members of the media interested in attending CERAWeek 2020 are required to apply for 
accreditation. 
Journalists should submit their request for media registration at the following link: 
https://bit.ly/2LoeSGU 
As always, the CERAWeek Media Relations Team is happy to provide a designated media work 
room as part of our conference-wide efforts to make journalists’ experiences convenient and 
productive at the conference. 
CERAWeek 2020 Media Work Room Amenities: 
• 
Fully-staffed Media Work Room adjacent to the CERAWeek Briefing Room
